newsitem.title: JORDAN: Foreign share of Jordan stock turnover at 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Foreign share of Jordan stock turnover at 11 pct.

text.p: Foreign investor activity in the Amman stock exchange dropped to 11 percent of total turnover in March compared to 26 percent in the previous month, the head of the bourse said on Wednesday.

Wahib al-Shair, director general of the Amman Financial Market (AFM), was quoted by the state news agency Petra as saying non-Jordanian Arab institutional and foreign fund buying comprised 11 percent of April's total turnover of 18 million dinars ($25.4 million) against 26 percent in February.
Non Jordanians bought two million dinars worth of stock in March against 3.9 million dinars in February, Shair said.

Global funds' stake on the bourse stood at end of 1996 at just 1.5 percent of a total market capitalisation of 3.5 billion dinars against a 33 percent held by non-Jordanian Arab investors. The rest is held by the government and Jordanian investors.
Trade by non-Jordanians, both Arabs and foreign, was 18 percent of 1996 total turnover of 248 million dinars.
